name: openmbd_male
citation: Tierney. OpenMBD: An Open-Source Multibody Dynamics Simulator for Biomechanics Research and Education. F1000Research, 2026.
description: Open-source multibody ellipsoid human body model, adult male.

Abdomen.description: Anterior trunk between pelvis and rib cage. Ellipsoids represent paired rectus abdominis, external obliques, and lower abdominal wall. Contact stiffness from Kroell et al. (1971) [9] scaled to regional soft-tissue area.

joint_restraints.convention: Restraints about the parent body axes, [Z, Y, X]; elastic_curve gives the moment (N m) resisting a deflection (deg) from the neutral angle; stiffness N m/rad, damping N m s/rad, friction N m. Built-in range-of-motion limits remain active.
joint_restraints.standing_offset: Hip, knee and ankle flexion/extension curves are shifted so the moment is zero in the standing pose (measured offsets removed: hip 8.6, knee 10.4, ankle 6.4 N m before sex scaling).
joint_restraints.sex_scaling: Male values; the female model uses x 0.80 except where sex-specific data exist.
